detail.longDescription: I view my career as a system engineer. Software, digitisation, and automation happen to have been part of that career. I'm not sure if they are defining attributes. Yet resource optimisation (reduction of effort or waste), and problem solving (working out what the problem is, and finding solutions) both resonate with me. What do you think your career is about? (This is for an upcoming meetup conversation) # SoftwareEngineering # programming
